Internal: a variable of numbers that a few other cells made text

Source: R/io.R
dot-jst_marker_values.Rd

Ruling R31, question 5 (Jeff, S380): N/A, - or . in a variable of numbers makes it text, and jstats never assumes such a cell is missing (a dash is "nil or rounded to zero" in an ABS table). The values found are named, with the line that reads them as missing. "A few": at most five values that are not numbers, and numbers in more than half the cells that are not empty (Jeff's okay of the lean, S380), so a Yes/No variable with a stray 3 is never told to read Yes and No as missing.

Usage

.jst_marker_values(x, max_values = 5L)

Arguments

x

The variable's cells, empty ones and any not to count left out by the caller or left in (an empty cell is not counted).

max_values

The most values that are not numbers.

Value

NULL, or list(values, counts): the values in the order first met.
